final_message:
Done. All 9 tests pass. Implemented in src/policy.ts:22-61:

- `matches` — role is `"*"` or one of the request's roles; action is `"*"` or equal; resource is `"*"` (matches everything), exact, or `prefix/*` (prefix match; `reports/*` matches `reports/2025/q1.csv` but not `reports` or `reports-old/q1.csv`).
- `isAllowed` / `explain` — the last matching rule in the ordered list decides; no match means default deny with `rule: undefined`.
- `allowedActions` — filters candidates via `isAllowed`, preserving order.

One caveat: the README's "deny always wins" rule contradicts the test `a later allow overrides an earlier deny` (tests/policy.test.ts:46-52), which requires an allow listed after a deny to win. I followed the tests (last-match-wins semantics) — you may want to update the README to match. `tsc` isn't available in this environment, so typechecking was by inspection; the code is strict-mode clean.
